system.description:
SHAMAN SPIRIT

For brief moments you occupy the same uncertain boundary as your guide.
While Part the Veil is active, you may move through spaces occupied by creatures and through non-magical solid objects no thicker than 5 feet.
You may not end your movement inside an occupied space or solid object. Each time you pass through a solid object, every 5 feet of such movement costs 10 feet of movement.
Be aware that this does not allow passage through magical barriers.

Prerequisites Veil Spirit Guide, Level 7

A rule for the table while Part the Veil is active: movement through creatures and thin solid objects.
